ranking.meaning: Three descriptive hypotheses potentially answered; factor is a planning discount, not a measured probability. All realized information floors are zero until inputs/route/reference/grant exist.

plans.title: Burst thermal
plans.buyer: Thermal architect chooses a burst schedule maximizing extra joules while the top-die maximum remains <=95 C; no hardware-control claim.
plans.ranges: Adopted menu v2: peak {80,100,120,140} W x duration {5,10,15,20} s. TRAIN uses [80,140] W at 1-W and [5,20] s at 0.1-s precision, excluding menu tuples. Keep the 24 contexts: (30 C,2500 W/m2K)/(40 C,1500 W/m2K) Robin pairs x initial 40/55 C x split 0.5/0.8 x rectangular/ramp/two-pulse, base20 W, start20 s, horizon120 s. Stack/materials unchanged.
plans.baseline: Multi-input spatial impulse-response/state-space ROM per cooling regime, with patch/initial-state response; compare RC/POD and complete exact-cache control. Scalar one-node RC alone is not the strongest incumbent.
plans.unit: K (maximum absolute top-temperature error); buyer regret J, objective max extra energy
plans.training: Freeze the first eight valid public TRAIN records per context in original generation order: 192 of the registered 960, not a new TRAIN law. Count all acquisition actually incurred, including the full 960 if that is how the source was acquired. Do not select by label or drop contexts. The 384 menu rows are held out as physical (context,peak,duration) tuples; 16 actions are reused across contexts but are not 384 independent designs.
plans.reference: Reuse all 576 distinct required rows (192 TRAIN +384 menu) with exact rebuilt-image/deck/material/observer identities. New attempt ceiling12: eight coarse launches (four analytic/conservation controls plus four missing physical rows), four separately charged refinements (two mesh and two dt), zero retries. If missing rows exceed this ceiling, HOLD; do not shrink the menu or train on truth. C1 2-3 CPU-min is historical; high0.10 CPU-h is an ASSUMPTION, refined cost2x. Scenario CPU =16*C1 +4 fit/check CPU-h, not a completion promise.
gaps: Current image presence and task adequacy receipts
Digest-checked disjoint public TRAIN/menu export and temporal maxima
Complete impulse-response/ROM acquisition and adaptive-solver policy/cost receipts
plans.notes: All24 contexts remain in the evidence return. k=8 gives three descriptive batches, not three independent package clusters. Fixed linear physics makes a strong ROM tie plausible: negative advantage is valuable information, not a reason to weaken the ROM. Replay uses the menu-v2 registration, never the old nine-action assumption.

plans.title: AI-chip cooling cell
plans.solver: OpenCFD/OpenFOAM periodic interior-cell conjugate route (release/source from exact producer manifest)
plans.buyer: Cooling designer chooses the interior-cell geometry at frozen representative point B; keep case-plane TIM2 <=85 C and the cell hydraulic allocation. Full cold plate/manifold is excluded.
plans.ranges: Point B: inlet40 C, interface1000 W, footprint1.50 L/min (flow action fixed1.5 L/min/kW), cell allocation25 kPa. Geometry channel width[0.2,0.5] mm, fin[0.2,0.5] mm, depth[1,3] mm; 30-mm cell footprint basis. Three frozen post-spreader maps: uniform, interior hot band, downstream hot band, ONLY after Data Collection supplies supported characterized maps/uncertainty; their ratio/center/width remain HUMAN_INPUT within existing domain. No invented flattening factor or scalar lid law.
plans.baseline: Strong same-map/material response maps, local interpolation/RBF/Kriging plus calibrated channel/thermal relations; exact lookup is a separate closed-bank control.
plans.unit: K (co-located TIM2 case-plane error); buyer pressure regret Pa only if the owner adopts that objective
plans.training: 16 independent valid geometries x three frozen maps =48 TRAIN cases. Hold out12 different geometries x the same maps =36; map identities are context, not learned privileges. Material/map support must match the real kit; no relabelling legacy heated-face temperature as TIM2 truth.
plans.reference: Require84 complete matching public cases before full replay. New attempt ceiling12: eight coarse (four analytic/conservation controls plus four missing rows), four paired refinements; failures consume those slots, zero retries. Historical0.45 CPU-h/cell is not new-map C1. Low/base/high0.45/0.90/1.35 CPU-h are explicit proxy hypotheses; refined2x gives16 equivalent cases +8 CPU-h fit/check reserve =15.2/22.4/29.6. Missing corpus beyond the cap ->HOLD.
gaps: Characterized representative vapour-chamber/post-spreader maps, TIM2 and uncertainty
Correct-interface native observers, conservation/convergence/code checks and image presence
All84 matching TRAIN/held-out rows and approved objective/P/Q/w
plans.notes: Point C is excluded by default; it needs the existing separately sourced NEEDS_OPTIONAL_STRESS_C rule, changed tuples and repricing. Do not tune inlet/lid/map parameters after seeing truth. Plate-face temperature plus local TIM2*q at the same coordinates defines the limit. Full plate remains out of scope. Budget route is a proposal, not spend authority.

plans.title: Precision robot-joint motor
plans.solver: GetDP 3.5.0 / Gmsh 4.15.2 revised 10p/12s double-layer magnetic panel
plans.buyer: Precision-joint integrator selects a smooth geometry/skew satisfying holding6 N m, peak12 N m, <=5% ripple and <=0.30/0.60 N m absolute ripple, cogging<=0.05 N m. Do not lower12 N m or infer2-s thermal duty from magnetostatics.
plans.ranges: Use the revised law grammar: magnet[1.5,4] mm, coverage[0.65,0.95], airgap[0.3,1] mm, tooth_frac[0.20,0.40], opening_frac[0.03,0.12], slot_bottom[34,42] mm; validity predicates mandatory. Discrete skew{0,2,4} deg; holdingJ10/gamma0, peakJ15/gamma0, coggingJ0. This is not the broader kit scaling box and not legacy8p/24s.
plans.baseline: Full signed-curve/Fourier Kriging/RBF response surfaces, calibrated nonlinear magnetic circuit and cached FE with identical geometry/command search. Match complete curves and near-zero cogging, not torque averages; exact lookup separately.
plans.unit: N m (signed curve error); regret holding ripple fraction (unit1) with absolute torque diagnostics
plans.training: Minimum16 independent geometries, all requested holding/peak/zero-current and phase-offset curves:11 raw sweeps/geometry as the conservative full-role hypothesis =176 curves. Hold out12 geometries =132 sweeps, with all skew siblings grouped;12 geometries produce36 skew actions, not36 independent clusters. Existing19 study geometries may supply TRAIN only after rights, disjointness and full-role support audit. The holding-only reference stage does not cover the buyer peak requirement.
plans.reference: Require308 valid reusable raw sweeps for the conservative target corpus, no new bank. New attempt ceiling6: four standard sweeps +two rung2 sweeps (failures counted, zero retries). A sweep is an angle curve, not a complete buyer decision. Four48-angle and two96-angle sweeps give384 field systems before any separately registered extras. Standard1.2 and rung2 8 allocated CPU-h are historical planning anchors; high uses observed6648/3600 and56500/3600 CPU-h, NOT portable p95. Add8 CPU-h fit/check reserve:28.8 baseline /46.775556 high; capped56. Missing peak/phase curves beyond this prefix ->HOLD. The source bookkeeping unit is shared-host elapsed x2 allocated cores, not measured aggregate user+system CPU; the new probe must report both without equating them. A raw-sweep timing is not full eleven-sweep decision C1.
gaps: Re-export with physical coordinates, full signed curves and complete peak/cogging roles
Exact skew/phase observer uncertainty, nonlinear applicability and current image presence
Supported full-role TRAIN kit and strongest comparator/material receipts
plans.notes: Register actual sweep multiplicity before dispatch: eleven is a conservative hypothesis, not proof of complete solver coverage. A changed count reprices first. gamma-5d and theta+d shifts are applied once; zero-current cogging has no relative denominator. All mandatory roles remain hard; missing peak rows make the full question UNRESOLVED. k12 remains a recommendation, not adopted power.

plans.ranges: Existing representative action ranges: bolt diameter[8,12] mm, spacing[40,70] mm, support thickness[8,16] mm, preload_max[8000,16000] N.
